verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe shows Render serves a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://render.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key), and Render documents a REST API that the spec describes. The core of the story is therefore delivered and directly verified. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec download (where it lives, its versioning and how completely it covers the REST API), and independent community corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://render.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
